title: [DEV] AAPSClient occasionally misses to download SGV
symptom: AAPSClient occasionally misses to download or backfill some SGV which is present in NS.
fix: Update to latest dev and use v1 API until the issue is sorted. Later, update to latest NS dev and test with v3 API.
evidence_quote: I recommend updating to latest dev and use v1 api until this issue is sorted
